title: JNIM Ambushes Africa Corps–FAMa Convoy Near Niono
detail: Around September 27-28, 2026, JNIM militants ambushed a convoy near Niono in Mali's Ségou region. Reports say at least seven soldiers were killed, including three or four Russian Africa Corps personnel and some Malian troops; four wounded Russians were reportedly airlifted out. Casualty figures and the exact date (Sept 27 vs 28) differ between reports and are not confirmed by Tier 1 sources.
